body_en: IHG One Rewards is currently offering a limited time 100% bonus on purchased points. With this, IHG One Rewards members can purchase points for as little as 0.5 cents each. Is this a good deal?

While I wouldn’t recommend buying points without a specific use in mind, there are absolutely ways to get outsized value, and this is in line with the best offers that we see from the program. With the right strategy, this could be an opportunity to get a significant discount on an IHG hotel stay, and I’ll show exactly how.
Link: Buy IHG One Rewards points with this promotion with a 100% bonus
Through 11:59PM ET on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, IHG One Rewards is offering a bonus on purchased points . Points can be purchased in increments of 1,000 points, and the bonus is tiered, as follows
Buy 5,000-10,000 points, receive an 80% bonus
Buy 11,000-39,000 points, receive a 90% bonus
Buy 40,000-200,000 points, receive a 100% bonus
Note that the purchase of IHG points doesn’t count toward elite status.

Ordinarily you can buy IHG One Rewards points for as little as one cent each (the pricing isn’t linear), before any discounts or bonuses. With that in mind, if you were eligible for a 100% bonus and purchased 200,000 IHG One Rewards points pre-bonus, you’d receive a total of 400,000 points at a cost of $2,000, which is a rate of 0.5 cents per IHG point.

While The Brand New IHG One Rewards Premier Select Credit Card ( learn more ), The New IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card ( learn more ), The New IHG One Rewards Credit Card ( learn more ), and The New IHG One Rewards Business Credit Card ( learn more ), offer a 30% discount on purchased points, that benefit only applies when buying points at the normal cost, and wouldn’t be applicable here.
IHG One Rewards ordinarily lets members purchase up to 150,000 points per calendar year, before any bonuses. However, during this promotion that cap has been increased to 200,000 points, pre-bonus.
How does this compare to other IHG buy points promotions?

When IHG One Rewards does offer a promotion on purchased points, the 100% bonus or 50% discount is the most common offer. A 100% bonus and 50% discount give you the same price per point, so you’ll typically pay 0.5 cents per point during a promotion.
Below is a chart with some of the recent promotions we saw from the program, before this one.

IHG One Rewards points purchases are processed by points.com, meaning they don’t count as a hotel purchase for the purposes of credit card spending. That means if you pay with an IHG credit card, you wouldn’t earn any bonus rewards, so it’s not treated as if it’s IHG spending.

Therefore I’d recommend using a card on which you’re trying to reach a minimum spending requirement , or otherwise, a credit card that maximizes your return on everyday spending . See this post for more on which credit cards are best for buying points.

IHG One Rewards has dynamic award pricing, which means there’s no minimum or maximum number of points a hotel stay can cost. Rather, the cost of an award stay generally correlates somewhat to the cost of a revenue stay.

However, that doesn’t necessarily mean you’ll get the same value with all hotel stays. There are many situations where you can get outsized value by buying points and then redeeming them. Let me just give a few examples, using stays I pulled up for random dates (again, pricing is dynamic, so this won’t reflect what you see every day).
For example, the Six Senses Kyoto is bookable for 165,000 points per night, and you could purchase those points for $825.

title_en: Is A Boeing 777X Bigger Than An Airbus A380?
title_zh: 波音 777X 比空客 A380 大吗？
summary: A closer look at the size and scale of the latest Triple-Seven.
summary_zh: 仔细看看最新的三七的大小和规模。
body_en: Daniel comes to Simple Flying with a business focused approach to the aviation world. Daniel enjoys analyzing strategy and how companies move against each other to gain a step ahead in the skies. Besides strategy, Daniel also has a passion for aircraft design and the history of aviation.

The Boeing 777X is not only Boeing's latest aircraft project, but it's also, in some metrics, the largest design to ever come out of Washington. Compared to the Boeing 747-8, it has a smaller fuselage and is rated for lower weights. However, the 777-9 variant is slightly longer while also having a greater wingspan (with wingtips extended, that is).

The largest Airbus in production is the A350-1000, a plane smaller than the 777X and almost identical to the prior 777-300ER in terms of dimensions. However, the largest Airbus ever is the famous A380. This colossal double-decker is the largest airliner ever made, the largest conventional plane currently flying, and the second-largest conventional aircraft to have been manufactured (behind the tragically destroyed Antonov AN-225 Mriya).

The Boeing 777-9 is 251 ft 9 in (76.73 m) long. This makes it the longest airliner ever put into production, ahead of the previous titleholder, the Boeing 747-8 (250 ft 2 in / 76.25 m). The A380, meanwhile, is 238 ft 8 in (72.73 m). This means that the A380 is 13 ft 1 in shorter or a full four meters.
Pick an aircraft to see how many are in the air right now
A380 747 787 A350 777 737 MAX A320neo More types

Although the A380 is an immense airliner, its length is one of the few metrics that have been superseded by other aircraft. The 777-9 and 747-8 have already been mentioned, but the Boeing 777-300ER is also longer than the A380, at 242 ft 4 in (73.9 m). In Airbus's lineup, the A350-1000 also beats the A380, as well as the out-of-production A340-600, which measured 247 ft 5 in (75.4 m).

The reason why the otherwise huge A380 is relatively short is that the design was optimized for a larger A380-900 . This gave it the economics of a shrink, whereas the A380-900 would have had more compelling per-seat costs. What Airbus ultimately did, however, was the equivalent of launching the A320 program with just the A319, or Boeing initially only offering the 747SP. These design choices, along with many other factors, contributed to the failure of the A380 program.

The Boeing 777-9 has a wider wingspan than any Boeing 747 variant. The 747-8 has a wingspan of 224 ft 5 in (68.4 m), whereas the 777-9's wingspan is 235 ft 5 in (71.75 m). This is more than any other passenger plane ever made, except the Airbus A380. Here, the superjumbo takes top position with a 261 ft 8 in (79.75 m) wingspan.

This is only behind the Antonov AN-225, the Hughes H-4 Hercules, and the Stratolaunch . Furthermore, while the Boeing 777-9 has a Maximum Takeoff Weight of 351T and the 777-8F is projected to lift up to 365T, the Airbus A380 is rated for up to 575T. The Boeing 747 is also rated for a higher MTOW in its recent iterations, with the 747-8 certified for 447T.
235 ft 5 in (71.75 m) unfolded, 212 ft 9 in (64.84 m) folded
4x General Electric CF6, Pratt & Whitney PW4000, Rolls-Royce RB211
4x Engine Alliance GP7200, Rolls-Royce Trent 900

Additionally, the Airbus A380 is also much taller than the Boeing 777X. The Boeing 777X retains the same maximum takeoff weight as the prior generations of 777s. However, there are significant changes, including a new wing, a new vertical stabilizer, new engines, a new interior, and more.

The new tail is 64 ft 1 in (19.53 m), while the old 777 reached a height of 60 ft 8 in (18.5 m). With so many design changes, this is one of the most substantial refreshes of any aircraft, comparable to the changes from the Airbus A300 to the A330.

The Boeing 777-300ER is by far the most successful variant of the Boeing 777 family. It sold over 800 copies on its own and essentially rendered quadjets obsolete, especially against the Airbus A340-600, a thirsty quadjet that was too heavy for its size . However, when Airbus redesigned the A350 to become a 777-sized airliner, Boeing's star widebody was in serious trouble.

The smaller 777s were already losing ground to the Airbus A330-300, so the clean-sheet A350 XWB, with its carbon-composite construction and the latest engines, spelled the end for the 777. The response was to address the 777's Achilles' Heel (its undersized wing) and to update it to make it as competitive as possible. Given that the A350 is a brand-new airliner, it would be a tall task.

The wing was substantially enlarged to enhance fuel efficiency, and the fuselage was extended to reduce its per-seat costs. Furthermore, Airbus and Boeing prefer not to compete head-to-head, so stretching the 777X allows it to have its own market position. This is evidenced in its orders, as many of its customers are also A350 operators who intend to use the 777X to offer a first-class cabin.

As previously mentioned, the 777X offers more floor space than the competing A350-1000, helping it fill its own niche. British Airways is a 777X customer and also an A350-1000 operator. It plans to offer first class on the Boeing, whereas its A350-1000s only fly with business class. The same is true for Cathay Pacific and Qatar Airways, among other notable examples. However, this size also presents a challenge.

The Boeing 777X is beginning to look similar to the Airbus A380, not just in its position as the largest airliner in production, but also in its order book. Of the type's 500+ passenger orders, 270 come from Emirates . There was significant input from Middle Eastern airlines on the design of the 777X, which required a plane capable of ultra-long-haul flying from hot and challenging airports.
body_zh: Daniel 带着以商业为中心的方式进入航空界，加入了 Simple Flying。丹尼尔喜欢分析战略以及公司如何相互竞争以取得领先一步。除了战略之外，丹尼尔还对飞机设计和航空历史充满热情。
波音 777X 不仅是波音最新的飞机项目，而且从某些指标来看，它也是华盛顿有史以来最大的设计。与波音 747-8 相比，它的机身更小，重量也更轻。然而，777-9 变体稍长，同时翼展更大（即翼尖延长）。
正在生产的最大的空客飞机是 A350-1000，该飞机比 777X 小，但在尺寸方面与之前的 777-300ER 几乎相同。然而，有史以来最大的空中客车公司是著名的 A380。这架巨大的双层客机是有史以来最大的客机、目前飞行中最大的常规飞机，也是已制造的第二大常规飞机（仅次于惨遭摧毁的安东诺夫 AN-225 Mriya）。
波音 777-9 长 251 英尺 9 英寸（76.73 m）。这使其成为有史以来投入生产的最长客机，领先于前任冠军波音 747-8（250 英尺 2 英寸/76.25 m）。与此同时，A380 的高度为 238 英尺 8 英寸（72.73 m）。这意味着 A380 的高度为 13 英尺 1 短或整整 4 米。
选择一架飞机，看看现在有多少架飞机在空中
尽管 A380 是一架巨大的客机，但其长度是少数被其他飞机取代的指标之一。 777-9 和 747-8 已经被提及，但波音 777-300ER 也比 A380 更长，达到 242 英尺 4 英寸（73.9 m）。在空中客车公司的产品阵容中，A350-1000 还击败了 A380 以及停产的 A340-600，后者的尺寸为 247 英尺 5 英寸（75.4 m）。
原本巨大的A380之所以相对较短，是因为该设计是针对更大的A380-900进行了优化。这使其具有缩减成本的经济效益，而 A380-900 的每座成本则更具吸引力。然而，空客最终所做的相当于仅推出 A319 来启动 A320 计划，或者波音最初只提供 747SP。这些设计选择以及许多其他因素导致了 A380 计划的失败。
波音 777-9 的翼展比任何波音 747 型号都更宽。 747-8 的翼展为 224 英尺 5 英寸（68.4 m），而 777-9 的翼展为 235 英尺 5 英寸（71.75 m）。这比除空中客车 A380 之外的任何其他客机都要多。在这里，超级巨型飞机以 261 英尺 8 英寸（79.75 m）的翼展占据首位。
这仅落后于安东诺夫 AN-225、休斯 H-4 大力士和平流层发射器。此外，波音 777-9 的最大起飞重量为 351 吨，777-8F 的最大起飞重量预计为 365 吨，而空客 A380 的额定起飞重量为 575 吨。波音 747 在最近的迭代中也获得了更高的 MTOW，其中 747-8 获得了 447T 认证。
展开时 235 英尺 5 英寸（71.75 m），折叠时 212 英尺 9 英寸（64.84 m）
4x 通用电气 CF6、普惠 PW4000、劳斯莱斯 RB211
4x 发动机 Alliance GP7200、劳斯莱斯 Trent 900
此外，空客 A380 也比波音 777X 高得多。波音 777X 保留了与前几代 777 相同的最大起飞重量。然而，还是有一些重大的变化，包括新的机翼、新的垂直稳定器、新的发动机、新的内饰等等。
新机尾长 64 英尺 1 英寸（19.53 m），而旧 777 的高度达到 60 英尺 8 英寸（18.5 m）。凭借如此多的设计变化，这是所有飞机中最实质性的更新之一，可与空客 A300 到 A330 的变化相媲美。
波音 777-300ER 是迄今为止波音 777 系列中最成功的型号。它本身就售出了 800 多架，基本上使四轴喷气式飞机变得过时，尤其是与空中客车 A340-600 相比，这种四轴喷气式飞机对于其尺寸来说太重了。然而，当空客重新设计A350成为777尺寸的客机时，波音的明星宽体客机遇到了严重的麻烦。
较小的 777 已经输给了空客 A330-300，因此采用碳复合材料结构和最新发动机的全新 A350 XWB 宣告了 777 的终结。我们的应对措施是解决 777 的致命弱点（其尺寸过小的机翼），并对其进行更新以使其尽可能具有竞争力。鉴于A350是一款全新客机，这将是一项艰巨的任务。
机翼被大幅扩大以提高燃油效率，机身被延长以降低每座成本。此外，空客和波音不喜欢正面竞争，因此扩展777X可以使其拥有自己的市场地位。这在其订单中得到了证明，因为其许多客户也是 A350 运营商，他们打算使用 777X 提供头等舱。
如前所述，777X 比竞争对手 A350-1000 提供更多的占地面积，帮助其填补了自己的空白。英国航空是 777X 的客户，也是 A350-1000 的运营商。该公司计划在波音飞机上提供头等舱，而其 A350-1000 飞机仅提供商务舱。国泰航空和卡塔尔航空等著名例子也是如此。然而，这个尺寸也带来了挑战。
波音 777X 开始与空客 A380 相似，不仅体现在其作为生产中最大客机的地位，而且体现在其订单簿上。该机型的 500 多名乘客订单中，有 270 份来自阿联酋航空。中东航空公司对 777X 的设计投入了大量精力，这需要一架能够从炎热且充满挑战的机场进行超长途飞行的飞机。

title_en: Twenty-five years ago, Sabena was declared bankrupt

body_en: Twenty-five years ago, Sabena was declared bankrupt - Aviation24.be
Home Do you remember? Twenty-five years ago, Sabena was declared bankrupt

That was twenty-five years ago, on 7 November 2001. Sabena was declared bankrupt. Flight SN690, an Airbus A340-311 registered OO-SCZ coming from Cotonou and Abidjan, was the last Sabena aircraft to land at Brussels on 7 November, with 266 passengers and 11 crew. End of history, completely unimaginable at the time for an airline that appeared as one of the flagships of the national economy and a legendary company in the world. Ten thousand workers then found themselves on the floor.

Sabena (Société Anonyme Belge d’Exploitation de la Navigation Aérienne) was a venerable old lady of 78 years. An internationally renowned company, the largest employer with 10,000 workers, 11 million passengers in 2000, 107 destinations in 48 countries. That’s the positive business card.

But Sabena was also known for its losses almost every year. The lack of vision of the state, which regained control before the evil marriage with Swissair in 1995. A lack of capital, a hectic social life, a growing debt of two billion euros at the end. Especially after Swissair has undertaken to take the best, pumping subsidiaries and passengers, with a certain folly sometimes, as with the massive purchase of 34 Airbus aircraft, which put the balance sheet definitively in the red.
The restructuring plans did not change anything. The Swiss, highly indebted, were the first to plunge.

Bloodless, abandoned by the Belgian State which was tired to invest at loss, Sabena filed for bankruptcy on 6 November 2001. Judge Anne Spiritus d’Assesse, President of the Brussels Commercial Court, declared Sabena’s bankruptcy on 6 November at 18:30 and the Official State Gazette later published the judgment as dated 7 November.
The government then organised a social plan, a conversion cell with the Regions asked to “manage” what remains as the worst failure of all times.

A private company is reborn from the ashes, SN Brussels Airlines. Curatorship led by Christian Van Buggenhout still manages today the final remnants of the company: aircraft engines, hotels, real estate in Brussels and Congo (Hotel Memling in Kinshasa).
At the judicial level, on the Swiss side, all the managers were acquitted. On the Belgian side, under criminal law, the story is not over yet.
The name Sabena survives in the Sabena Flight Academy, the French maintenance company Sabena Technics and the Belgian one, Sabena Aerospace.
Sabena filed for bankruptcy on November 7, 2001.
There is a slight date error : Sabena was declared bankrupt by the Brussels Business Court ( = Tribunal de Commerce ) on Tuesday, Nov. 6, 2001 at 18h00 loc.
Indeed, the last flights landed at EBBR on Nov. 7.

I tremendously flying SABENA from NY to Nice. It was a good airline. I never had the problems I had heard about. The same with Swiss Air. I want aware of the tension between the two. Thanks for that flashback.

To be fair it has to be said that if Swissair had not taken over Sabena in 1995, it would have folded then and there. Never in its history did it manage to make a profit. And the service was sub optimal. Swissair only bought it, because they needed a foothold inside the EU to be able to operate freely, and Sabena was the only airline for sale. While they did not handle it perfectly, the Sabena purchase played a big role in Swissair’s own demise.
I flew two times with Sabena during their last week of operations, and the airline was clearly falling apart. Outside of Belgium Sabena was the acronym for “Such A Bloody Experience Never again.”

Fortunately, the new (SN) Brussels Airlines became a much better airline, so something good did come from it in the end. I really hope that it will survive the current crisis, unlike its predecessor, it has deserved it.
Still remember that day vividly and very sadly though I was not even a member of the company, just a simple regular passenger..
I loved flying SABENA non-stop from Boston to BRU from 1999-2001. Never had any problems, A330 aircraft was comfortable and service was very good. Good memories!

首页 你还记得吗？ 25年前，Sabena被宣告破产

那是二十五年前的 2001 年 11 月 7 日。Sabena 被宣布破产。 SN690 航班是一架注册为 OO-SCZ 的空客 A340-311，从科托努和阿比让起飞，是最后一架于 11 月 7 日降落在布鲁塞尔的 Sabena 飞机，载有 266 名乘客和 11 名机组人员。历史的终结，对于一家作为国民经济旗舰之一、世界传奇企业出现的航空公司来说，在当时是完全不可想象的。随后，一万名工人发现自己倒在了地板上。
Sabena（Société Anonyme Belge d’Exploitation de la Navigation Aérienne）是一位 78 岁的令人尊敬的老太太。一家国际知名公司，最大的雇主，2000 年拥有 10,000 名员工、1100 万名旅客、48 个国家的 107 个目的地。这就是积极的名片。
但萨贝纳也几乎每年都因亏损而闻名。国家缺乏远见，在 1995 年与瑞士航空的邪恶联姻之前重新获得了控制权。缺乏资本，忙碌的社交生活，最终债务增加了 20 亿欧元。尤其是在瑞航承诺采取最好的措施、输送子公司和乘客之后，有时会带来一定程度的愚蠢，例如大量购买 34 架空客飞机，这导致资产负债表最终出现亏损。
重组计划没有改变任何事情。负债累累的瑞士首先陷入困境。
Bloodless 被厌倦了亏损投资的比利时政府抛弃，Sabena 于 2001 年 11 月 6 日申请破产。布鲁塞尔商事法院院长 Anne Spiritus d’Assesse 法官于 11 月 6 日 18:30 宣布 Sabena 破产，官方国家公报随后于 11 月 7 日公布了判决。
随后，政府组织了一项社会计划，成立了一个转换小组，要求各地区“管理”有史以来最严重的失败。
一家私营公司从灰烬中重生，这就是 SN 布鲁塞尔航空公司。克里斯蒂安·范·布根豪特 (Christian Van Buggenhout) 领导的管理者至今仍管理着公司的最后残余：飞机发动机、酒店、布鲁塞尔和刚果的房地产（金沙萨的梅姆林酒店）。
在司法层面，瑞士方面所有的管理人员都被无罪释放。在比利时方面，根据刑法，故事还没有结束。
Sabena 这个名字在 Sabena 飞行学院、法国维修公司 Sabena Technics 和比利时维修公司 Sabena Aerospace 中得以保留。
Sabena于2001年11月7日申请破产。
有一个轻微的日期错误：Sabena 于 2001 年 11 月 6 日星期二 18:00 被布鲁塞尔商业法院 (= Tribunal de Commerce) 宣布破产。
事实上，最后一批航班已于 11 月 7 日降落在 EBBR。
我乘坐 SABENA 从纽约飞往尼斯。这是一家很好的航空公司。我从来没有遇到过我听说过的问题。瑞士航空也是如此。我想了解两者之间的紧张关系。谢谢你的闪回。
公平地说，如果瑞士航空没有在 1995 年收购 Sabena，它就会在当时就倒闭了。在其历史上，它从未成功盈利过。而且服务不是最优的。瑞士航空之所以买下它，是因为他们需要在欧盟境内立足才能自由运营，而萨贝纳航空是唯一一家被出售的航空公司。尽管他们处理得并不完美，但对萨贝纳的收购在瑞航自身的灭亡中发挥了重要作用。
在 Sabena 运营的最后一周，我乘坐过两次飞机，这家航空公司显然正在崩溃。在比利时境外，Sabena 是“这样的血腥经历再也不会发生”的缩写。
幸运的是，新的（SN）布鲁塞尔航空公司成为一家更好的航空公司，所以最终它确实带来了一些好处。我真的希望它能够度过当前的危机，与它的前身不同，它是应得的。
虽然我什至不是公司的一员，只是一个普通的乘客，但那一天仍然历历在目，非常悲伤。
我喜欢从 1999 年到 2001 年乘坐 SABENA 从波士顿直飞 BRU 的航班。从来没有出现过任何问题，A330飞机很舒适，服务也很好。美好的回忆！

title_en: My 9 Favorite Hotel Toiletry Brands, From Aesop To Le Labo, And More
title_zh: 我最喜欢的 9 个酒店盥洗用品品牌，从 Aesop 到 Le Labo 等等
summary: Hotels partner with luxury brands on toiletries and skincare. Here are nine lines I'm most excited to see, from Le Labo and Bamford to Aesop, and where to find them.
summary_zh: 酒店与奢侈品牌合作提供洗漱用品和护肤品。以下是我最兴奋看到的九个系列，从 Le Labo 和 Bamford 到 Aesop，以及
body_en: Luxury hotel brands try to differentiate themselves in all kinds of ways. One (arguably) minor way they do so is by partnering with other luxury brands on their toiletry and skincare lines. While I’m not suggesting that you should pick a hotel brand because of the toiletries that they offer, I think I’m not alone in preferring some brands to others.

In this post, I’d like to share my favorite hotel toiletry brands, and then I’m curious to hear what brands OMAAT readers prefer. To be clear, my rankings are based purely on my perception of products and brands, from the packaging, to the scent, to how it feels using them, to memories I associate with them. I’m not claiming any authority with my opinion, so please don’t ask me to defend my preferences!

Still, I’m sure I’m not alone in getting more excited about some toiletry brands than others. With that out of the way, below are some of my favorite hotel toiletry brands (let me also emphasize that not every single property belonging to these groups has the brand standard toiletries).

Le Labo generally supplies toiletries for EDITION and Park Hyatt hotels, as well as select Fairmont properties, and it’s probably my single favorite toiletry brand. I love how there are different scents, and how they’re often customized for individual hotels (with the branding on the bottles even reflecting that). I enjoy the scents, and also appreciate that they seem to be fairly mild.

Bamford toiletries are generally available at ultra-luxury hotel group Capella, and sister brand Patina. I absolutely love Bamford, and find the product scents to be pleasant, and I also like the simplicity of the branding. For airline geeks, Bamford is also nowadays the premium toiletry partner of Cathay Pacific, so don’t be surprised if you see these products in Cathay Pacific lounges, and onboard the carrier’s flights.

Within the past few years, Ritz-Carlton has started partnering with Diptyque on toiletries. What an absolutely massive upgrade this is, compared to the previous Asprey Purple Rain collection, which I personally found to be completely unremarkable. I find Diptyque to have a very pleasant scent without being overpowering. It’s something I otherwise associate with Qatar Airways, as it’s the only major airline to partner with the brand. Speaking of changes in recent years in the luxury Marriott portfolio, St. Regis has moved to SACHAJUAN, which I find to be unmemorable.

A few years ago, Waldorf Astoria made the switch from Salvatore Ferragamo toiletries to Aesop toiletries. I’d consider that to be a significant upgrade. I love the scent of Aesop, and it can’t help but always remind me of Cathay Pacific back in the day (which, as noted above, has now switched to Bamford).

I love BVLGARI toiletries, including the packaging, scent, and feeling of using them. The catch is that while many hotels have BVLGARI toiletries, there’s not much consistency as to which brands have them. Yes, as you’d expect, BVLGARI hotels have these products, but that’s a small hotel group, with under 10 properties. On top of that, you’ll find BVLGARI toiletries at select properties of Four Seasons, Rosewood, and more.

Acqua Di Parma is another one of my favorite hotel toiletry brands, in terms of packaging and scent. The catch is that there’s not a major hotel group that consistently stocks these products, though they’re common enough among hotel groups that I feel good about including it on the list. For example, while not brand standard, the St. Regis Venice uses Acqua Di Parma products.

Molton Brown makes great products (I particularly like the soap). While no major hotel group consistently has Molton Brown products, I find that they’re pretty common at luxury hotels, including at many Marriott Luxury Collection properties.

I think Byredo is worth mentioning, as you’ll find the Bal d’Afrique product line at many InterContinental properties, and the Le Chemin product line at many Luxury Collection properties. While I don’t like this quite as much as some of the brands mentioned above, I appreciate that it’s often available at more mid-range properties, where you won’t typically find brands like Aesop and Le Labo.

Admittedly this is a bit lower end than the other options, but I wanted to also throw in a toiletry brand from a more mid-range hotel brand. For upscale hotels, I’d say that MALIN+GOETZ, available at Le Meridien properties, is probably my favorite line.

The above are nine of my favorite hotel toiletry lines. As you can see, some are pretty consistently available at select hotel brands, while others are frequently offered, though not consistently at any brand. I don’t claim that my opinions are right, but the above are the toiletry brands I’m typically most excited to see at hotels.
What are your favorite hotel toiletry brands?
body_zh: 豪华酒店品牌试图通过各种方式使自己与众不同。他们这样做的一个（可以说）次要方式是与其他奢侈品牌在化妆品和护肤品系列上合作。虽然我并不是建议您因为酒店提供的洗漱用品而选择酒店品牌，但我认为我并不是唯一一个更喜欢某些品牌而不是其他品牌的人。
在这篇文章中，我想分享我最喜欢的酒店盥洗用品品牌，然后我很好奇 OMAAT 读者更喜欢哪些品牌。需要明确的是，我的排名纯粹基于我对产品和品牌的看法，从包装到气味，到使用它们的感觉，再到我与它们相关的记忆。我的观点并不具有任何权威，所以请不要要求我捍卫我的偏好！
不过，我确信我并不是唯一一个对某些盥洗用品品牌比其他品牌更感兴趣的人。除此之外，以下是我最喜欢的一些酒店盥洗用品品牌（我还要强调的是，并非属于这些群体的每家酒店都拥有品牌标准盥洗用品）。
Le Labo 通常为艾迪逊酒店和柏悦酒店以及部分费尔蒙酒店供应洗漱用品，这可能是我最喜欢的洗漱用品品牌。我喜欢有不同的香味，以及它们通常是如何为个别酒店定制的（瓶子上的品牌甚至反映了这一点）。我喜欢这些气味，也很欣赏它们看起来相当温和。
Bamford洗漱用品一般在超豪华酒店集团Capella及其姊妹品牌Patina有售。我非常喜欢 Bamford，发现产品气味令人愉悦，而且我也喜欢品牌的简洁性。对于航空迷来说，Bamford 如今也是国泰航空的高级盥洗用品合作伙伴，因此，如果您在国泰航空的休息室和该航空公司的航班上看到这些产品，请不要感到惊讶。

在过去的几年里，丽思卡尔顿酒店开始与 Diptyque 在洗漱用品领域进行合作。与之前的 Asprey Purple Rain 系列相比，这绝对是一次巨大的升级，我个人认为 Asprey Purple Rain 系列完全不起眼。我发现 Diptyque 有一种非常宜人的香味，但又不会太浓烈。这让我与卡塔尔航空联系在一起，因为它是唯一一家与该品牌合作的主要航空公司。说到近年来万豪豪华酒店组合的变化，瑞吉酒店已经搬到了 SACHAJUAN，我觉得这并不令人难忘。
几年前，华尔道夫酒店 (Waldorf Astoria) 将 Salvatore Ferragamo 盥洗用品更换为 Aesop 盥洗用品。我认为这是一个重大升级。我喜欢 Aesop 的香味，它总是让我想起当年的国泰航空（如上所述，现在已改用 Bamford）。
我喜欢宝格丽的洗漱用品，包括它的包装、香味和使用的感觉。问题是，虽然许多酒店都有宝格丽 (BVLGARI) 洗漱用品，但哪些品牌拥有这些洗漱用品的一致性并不高。是的，正如您所料，BVLGARI 酒店有这些产品，但那是一个小型酒店集团，拥有不到 10 家酒店。除此之外，您还可以在 Four Seasons、Rosewood 等精选酒店找到 BVLGARI 洗浴用品。
就包装和香味而言，帕尔玛之水是我最喜欢的酒店盥洗用品品牌之一。问题是，没有一个主要的酒店集团持续库存这些产品，尽管它们在酒店集团中很常见，所以我很高兴将其列入清单。例如，虽然不是品牌标准，但威尼斯瑞吉酒店使用帕尔玛之水产品。
Molton Brown 生产很棒的产品（我特别喜欢肥皂）。虽然没有一家大型酒店集团始终拥有 Molton Brown 产品，但我发现它们在豪华酒店（包括许多万豪豪华精选酒店）中很常见。
我认为 Byredo 值得一提，因为您会在许多洲际酒店找到 Bal d’Afrique 产品线，在许多豪华精选酒店找到 Le Chemin 产品线。虽然我不像上面提到的一些品牌那样喜欢这个品牌，但我很欣赏它通常在中端酒店提供，在那里你通常不会找到像 Aesop 和 Le Labo 这样的品牌。
诚然，这比其他选择要低一些，但我还想加入一个中档酒店品牌的盥洗用品品牌。对于高档酒店，我想说艾美酒店的 MALIN+GOETZ 可能是我最喜欢的系列。
以上是我最喜欢的九个酒店盥洗用品系列。正如您所看到的，有些在选定的酒店品牌中相当一致地提供，而另一些则经常提供，但在任何品牌上都不一致。我并不认为我的观点是正确的，但以上是我通常最高兴在酒店看到的化妆品品牌。

summary_zh: 调查人员已证实，11 月 1 日，里尔 60 N722BD 飞机的机尾部分在撞击西棕榈滩附近的地面之前分离，导致一名乘客死亡。
body_en: Florida Learjet crash: flight data and recovered elevator offer clues - Aviation24.be
Home Miscellaneous Accidents Florida Learjet crash: flight data and recovered elevator offer clues

Investigators have confirmed that part of Learjet 60 N722BD’s tail separated before it struck the ground near West Palm Beach on 1 November, killing all nine people aboard. However, whether that separation caused the loss of control or resulted from the aircraft’s rapid descent remains unresolved.

The aircraft was flying from Austin-Bergstrom, Texas, to North Eleuthera in the Bahamas. The NTSB identifies its operator as Aurora Aviation, trading as Upper Jet. Its latest published update, dated 5 November, confirms that wreckage recovery remains under way; no probable cause has been established.

Flightradar24’s tracking shows that the 2004-built business jet departed Austin at approximately 15:37 UTC. After cruising at higher altitude, it descended towards 35,000 feet over southern Florida, before briefly climbing and entering a steep right-hand descent at around 17:48 UTC.

The crew’s radio calls provide important context. According to NTSB briefing details reported by Aviation Week , the pilots described light clear icing, considered manageable, and moderate turbulence causing altitude deviations of approximately 700 feet. They subsequently reported precipitation and requested a climb to 37,000 feet. Shortly after receiving clearance, they declared an emergency, reporting a rapid descent and an overspeed condition. These are observations made by the crew, not findings that icing caused the accident.

The downloadable Flightradar24 data illustrates the descent’s severity: recorded altitude falls from 31,350 feet at 17:48:39 UTC to 8,750 feet at 17:49:23 — approximately 22,600 feet in 44 seconds. That represents an average recorded descent rate of about 30,800 feet per minute over that interval.

Crucially, these are tracking measurements, not a complete flight-recorder reconstruction. The final entries repeat 8,750 feet while position continues changing: they do not demonstrate that the aircraft levelled off. Nor should the reported groundspeed be confused with airspeed or used alone to establish an overspeed. The latter was reported separately by the crew. Source: Flightradar24’s published data .
The elevator discovery — evidence, but not yet an explanation

At the 3 November briefing, NTSB member Thomas Chapman said investigators had recovered most of the left elevator in three pieces, between approximately 2.1 and 6.1 kilometres from the impact site. The elevator is a movable tail surface used to control the aircraft’s nose-up and nose-down movement. Its recovery away from the main wreckage establishes separation before impact.

The unresolved question is the sequence. Did a control-surface failure initiate the loss of control, or did aerodynamic loads during the dive tear the elevator away? Investigators have not determined when it detached. Weather is also a key investigative focus, but neither the crew’s icing reports nor the debris distribution establishes the initiating cause.

On 5 November, the NTSB reported that excavation had begun the previous evening and that part of an engine had been found. Wreckage has also been recovered from nearby roofs and will be transferred to a secure location for examination.

Maintenance records indicated that a cockpit voice recorder had been installed, but investigators initially could not confirm whether it remained aboard. The latest official update does not announce its recovery. For now, the evidence documents an exceptionally rapid descent and an in-flight separation — not why the emergency began.

首页 其他事故 佛罗里达州里尔喷气机坠毁：飞行数据和恢复的电梯提供线索
调查人员已证实，11 月 1 日，里尔 60 N722BD 飞机在撞击西棕榈滩附近的地面之前，机尾部分分离，导致机上 9 人全部遇难。然而，这种分离是导致失控还是飞机快速下降造成的仍然悬而未决。
这架飞机从德克萨斯州奥斯汀-伯格斯特罗姆飞往巴哈马群岛的北伊柳塞拉。 NTSB 认定其运营商为 Aurora Aviation，交易名称为 Upper Jet。其最新发布的更新日期为 11 月 5 日，确认残骸打捞仍在进行中；尚未确定可能的原因。
Flightradar24 的追踪显示，这架 2004 年制造的商务飞机于世界标准时间 15:37 左右从奥斯汀起飞。在更高海拔巡航后，它在佛罗里达州南部上空下降到 35,000 英尺的高度，然后在世界标准时间 17:48 左右短暂爬升并进入陡峭的右侧下降。
机组人员的无线电呼叫提供了重要的背景信息。根据《航空周刊》报道的 NTSB 简报详细信息，飞行员描述了轻微的清晰结冰，被认为是可以控制的，以及导致高度偏差约 700 英尺的中度湍流。他们随后报告了降雨并要求爬升至 37,000 英尺的高度。在获得许可后不久，他们宣布进入紧急状态，报告了快速下降和超速情况。这些是机组人员的观察结果，而不是结冰导致事故的发现。
可下载的 Flightradar24 数据说明了下降的严重程度：记录的高度从 UTC 时间 17:48:39 的 31,350 英尺下降到 17:49:23 的 8,750 英尺——大约在 44 秒内下降了 22,600 英尺。这表示在此期间记录的平均下降率约为每分钟 30,800 英尺。
至关重要的是，这些是跟踪测量，而不是完整的飞行记录器重建。最终条目重复 8,750 英尺，同时位置不断变化：它们并不表明飞机已保持平稳。报告的地速也不应与空速混淆或单独用于确定超速。后者由机组人员单独报告。资料来源：Flightradar24 公布的数据。
电梯的发现——证据，但尚未解释
在 11 月 3 日的简报会上，国家运输安全委员会 (NTSB) 成员托马斯·查普曼 (Thomas Chapman) 表示，调查人员已将左侧电梯的大部分分为三块，距离撞击地点约 2.1 至 6.1 公里。升降舵是一个可移动的尾翼面，用于控制飞机的机头向上和机头向下运动。它从主残骸中恢复，在撞击前建立了分离。
未解决的问题是顺序。是控制面故障导致失控，还是潜水过程中的空气动力载荷导致升降舵脱落？调查人员尚未确定其何时分离。天气也是一个关键的调查焦点，但船员的结冰报告和碎片分布都无法确定引发原因。
11 月 5 日，国家运输安全委员会报告说，挖掘工作已于前一天晚上开始，并发现了发动机的一部分。残骸也已从附近的屋顶找到，并将被转移到安全地点进行检查。
维修记录显示驾驶舱录音机已安装，但调查人员最初无法确认它是否仍留在飞机上。最新的官方更新并没有宣布恢复。目前，证据显示飞机下降得异常迅速，并在飞行中发生分离——这并不是紧急情况开始的原因。

title_en: Atmos Rewards Summit Card 3x Points On Foreign Purchases: Any Catch?
title_zh: Atmos Rewards Summit 卡在国外购物可获 3 倍积分：有什么收获吗？
summary: The Atmos Rewards Summit Card earns 3x points on foreign purchases with no cap and no foreign transaction fees. Here's why the bonus looks as good as it sounds.

body_en: The $395 annual fee Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite ® Credit Card ( learn more ) is the premium personal credit card of Atmos Rewards, which is the combined loyalty program of Alaska & Hawaiian.

There are lots of reasons to get this card , from a huge welcome bonus , to a great return on spending, to valuable perks just for being a cardmember, like free points sharing and waived partner award booking fees . It’s a card I’ve already applied for .

In this post, I’d like to talk about what might just be the most interesting aspect to spending on the Atmos Rewards Summit Card, which borders on seeming too good to be true. Specifically, I’m talking about how the card earns 3x points on all foreign purchases, with no caps, which is a pretty unheard of bonus category.
Link: Learn more about the Atmos™ Rewards Summit Visa Infinite ® Credit Card
The best one-size-fits-all card for foreign purchases

The Atmos Rewards Summit Card offers 3x points on eligible foreign transactions, with no caps. This applies to both the primary cardmember and to any authorized users (authorized users can be added to the card at no extra cost). Specifically, eligible foreign purchases include
Purchases made in US dollars if the transaction is made or processed outside the United States
In the interest of being thorough, let me copy and paste the portion of the terms addressing this

3 Points for eligible Foreign Transactions: Earn 3 points for every $1 spent on eligible foreign transaction Net Purchases (1) made in a foreign currency, or (2) made in U.S. dollars if the transaction is made or processed outside of the United States and US Territories. Bank of America is not responsible for how foreign transactions are billed to the card.

Let me emphasize that the card has no foreign transaction fees, so not only are you not paying those fees, but you’re being rewarded very handsomely. The exchange rates used by the card are also totally fair, and competitive.

Personally, I value Atmos Rewards points at 1.5 cents each, so I’d consider that to be a 4.5% return on all foreign purchases, which is unrivaled. If you have an eligible Bank of America account, you can even get a 10% relationship bonus , meaning you could net 3.3x points per dollar spent.

While there are some cards that might be slightly more rewarding for specific categories of foreign spending — like dining, airfare, or hotels — there’s not another card that’s broadly this rewarding for all foreign spending.
Keep in mind that this is only the start of the rewards you get for spending on the card
You earn one status point for every $2 spent on the Atmos Rewards Summit Card , so if you’re trying to earn elite status , that will help you greatly

If you have the Atmos Rewards Summit Card , you can earn a 100,000-point Global Companion Award if you spend $60,000 on the card in an anniversary year; if you can get full value from that certificate, that’s the equivalent of an incremental 1.67 points per dollar spent

Admittedly this is a very specific situation, but if you were to spend $60,000 abroad, you’d earn 180,000 Atmos Rewards points, 30,000 Atmos Rewards status points (not including the 10,000 status points boost the card offers annually), and a 100,000-point Global Companion Award.

If you want to take it a step further, those 40,000 Atmos Rewards status points are enough to earn Atmos Rewards Gold status, which gets you oneworld Sapphire , offering perks like priority services and lounge access. That’s a pretty incredible setup, eh?
Is 3x points on foreign spending too good to be true?
As you’d expect, there are a lot of questions about the Atmos Rewards Summit Card 3x points on foreign spending
“I’ve looked but I couldn’t find what the terms are for the 3x points on foreign purchases. Is there an annual limit? Does it need to be combined with domestic spend?”

如果您想更进一步，这 40,000 个 Atmos 奖励等级积分足以获得 Atmos 奖励金级等级，获得 oneworld 蓝宝石卡，提供优先服务和休息室使用权等福利。这是一个非常令人难以置信的设置，不是吗？

Under this contract, ViON is responsible for providing on-demand, on-premise computing, networking and storage solutions for a variety of systems and applications for the command’s research, development, testing and evaluation core infrastructures, laboratory and data center environments. This contract includes options, which if exercised, would bring the maximum contract value to $49,990,000. The Space and Naval Warfare Systems Command, San Diego, is the contracting activity (N00039-17-D-0003). body_en: Product Realization Pop Quiz will.herth@pen… Mon, 04/18/2016 - 17:42 How well do you understand Product Realization? Aerospace and Defense companies such as yours are looking for ways to gain insight into program decisions that impact cost, timing and quality. To effectively compete and achieve program execution excellence, you need to make manufacturing a core part of the development process. Put your Product Realization knowledge to test with this pop quiz. Complete the short quiz and be entered to win one of two $50 Amazon gifts cards! To help you with the answers, please download the white paper Product realization facilitates a collaborative approach . Content loading... Please enable javascript! Test Your Product Realization Knowledge What is product realization for Aerospace and Defense companies? It is the final phase of the project It is a process-driven approach to the entire manufacturing lifecycle starting with “Concept to build” through “Build to delivery” It is the decision that a design meets all requirements of OEMs and suppliers How does a product realization solution support program execution excellence? Through simulation of production alternatives to virtually verify the manufacturing processes and tooling throughout the entire manufacturing lifecycle – full digital twin Through concurrent maturing of manufacturing processes and tooling with the design thus impacting the design prior to release Through integration of advanced manufacturing technologies and automation with the ability to virtually commission robotics and CNC equipment Through the ability to trace a requirement to a design feature to an inspection within the electronic work instructions – complete digital thread Through the ability to easily and electronically compare the as-designed to as-built for delivery – complete digital thread All of the above Name the product realization strategy that helps understand the manufacturing implications of multiple design alternatives. (See page 6 of the white paper.) Shift left Shift right Shift up Shift down Which of the following is not a benefit of implementing the shift left strategy? The program team can make manufacturing decisions concurrently with the product design Reduces the number of program changes and ensures smooth transition from product development to production Links requirements to individual test request, test procedure and instrumentation Provides the early digital twin to enable virtual verification as the digital twin matures along with product design Which are the benefits of an ERP-PLM-MES integration? Seamless delivery of 3D work instructions from PLM to MES Shop floor access to released computer numerical control (CNC) programs Ability to digitally compare the as-built to as-designed in a single system Ability to virtually commission robotics and automation All of the above None of the above Test Your Product Realization Knowledge Thank you for participating! Winners will be notified via email.

Mon, 04/18/2016 - 17:42 您对产品实现的理解程度如何？像您这样的航空航天和国防公司正在寻找方法来深入了解影响成本、时间和质量的项目决策。为了有效竞争并实现卓越的项目执行，您需要将制造作为开发过程的核心部分。通过这个小测验来测试您的产品实现知识。完成小测验即可赢取两张 50 美元亚马逊礼品卡中的一张！为了帮助您找到答案，请下载白皮书 产品实现促进协作方法。内容正在加载...请启用javascript！测试您的产品实现知识 航空航天和国防公司的产品实现是什么？这是项目的最后阶段 这是整个制造生命周期的流程驱动方法，从“概念到构建”一直到“构建到交付” 这是设计满足 OEM 和供应商所有要求的决定 产品实现解决方案如何支持卓越的项目执行？通过模拟生产替代方案，以虚拟方式验证整个制造生命周期中的制造工艺和工具 - 完整的数字孪生 通过制造工艺和工具与设计的同步成熟，从而影响发布前的设计 通过将先进制造技术和自动化与虚拟调试机器人和 CNC 设备的能力相集成 通过在电子工作指令中跟踪设计特征的要求到检查的能力 - 完整的数字线程 通过能够轻松地以电子方式比较设计与交付时的竣工 - 完整的数字线程 上述所有内容 为产品命名实现策略有助于理解多种设计方案对制造的影响。 （参见白皮书第6页。） 左移 右移 上移 下移 以下哪一项不是实施左移策略的好处？项目团队可以在产品设计的同时做出制造决策 减少项目变更的数量并确保从产品开发到生产的平稳过渡 将需求链接到单独的测试请求、测试程序和仪器 提供早期数字孪生，以便随着数字孪生与产品设计一起成熟，实现虚拟验证 ERP-PLM-MES 集成的好处有哪些？从 PLM 到 MES 无缝交付 3D 工作指令 车间访问已发布的计算机数控 (CNC) 程序 能够在单个系统中以数字方式比较竣工与设计 能够虚拟调试机器人和自动化 所有以上都不是 测试您的产品实现知识 感谢您的参与！获奖者将通过电子邮件收到通知。
